_about: Hand-checked against gymrek-lab/LongTR at 2be6cf5ec0b108601719c16171a3f0099d1cb88d (tag v1.2) on 2026-09-29, from README.md, Makefile, src/region.cpp, src/hipstr_main.cpp, src/snp_bam_processor.cpp and test_data/ at that commit, the v1.2 release notes, api.anaconda.org, and the header and tags of STRhub's ont_slices/HG00113.codis.bam.

install.documented: git clone (over SSH), then `make` in the repository root; needs gcc 7+, cmake 3.12+, googletest and zlib, and the Makefile clones and builds htslib and spoa itself

published.where: https://api.anaconda.org/package/bioconda/longtr (versions: 1.2); https://github.com/gymrek-lab/LongTR/releases/tag/v1.2 (no assets); README.md mentions no conda package, container image or binary download

extra_inputs.what: TR regions BED in LongTR's own layout: CHROM, 1-based START, END, MOTIF (several motifs comma-separated), optional NAME; no header line
extra_inputs.where: README.md:37,44,142-161; src/region.cpp:42-55; https://github.com/gymrek-lab/LongTR/releases/tag/v1.2 (release notes: layout changed from HipSTR's CHROM START END MOTIF_LEN NUM_COPY NAME)
extra_inputs.revised: 2026-09-29: STRhub now supplies a chrom/start/end/motif regions file for ont-bam-hg38 (datasets/ont-bam-hg38/regions/motif.bed, the 20 CODIS loci inside the ONT slices).

runnable_on_strhub_data.why: 2026-09-29: STRhub now supplies a chrom/start/end/motif regions file for ont-bam-hg38 (datasets/ont-bam-hg38/regions/motif.bed, the 20 CODIS loci inside the ONT slices). With the motif-in-column-4 file from STRhub's regions library as --regions, and the documented --bam-samps/--bam-libs options naming the sample (the ONT slice has no @RG), the documented command has everything it needs on ont-bam-hg38. The library's start is the BED 0-based one; LongTR reads it as 1-based, a one-base shift at the tract edge.

was.why: --regions is required and must be in LongTR's CHROM/START/END/MOTIF[/NAME] layout. None of the layouts STRhub writes has the motif in column 4: HipSTR and GangSTR put the period there, BED4 a locus name (e.g. D1S1656), STRsearch the period after a header line. src/region.cpp:42-47 stops on anything but an alphabetic motif, so no STRhub regions file fits, whichever dataset it is attached to. As specified for this benchmark, STRhub attaches regions only to the Illumina BAM datasets anyway.

notes: Command joined from the multi-line Quick Start with runs of whitespace collapsed to one space; ',...' is literal in the README. The Quick Start is labelled for PacBio HiFi (README.md:32); ONT is supported (README.md:1) and README.md:69 suggests raising the gap-opening log-probabilities (--alignment-params f,g) for noisier reads. STRhub's ONT slice has no @RG header line, so LongTR stops at src/hipstr_main.cpp:489 unless the documented --bam-samps/--bam-libs are added (README.md:99-100,124-133). --phased-bam is not a blocker: the slice was haplotagged with longphase (@PG) and about half its reads carry HP; LongTR skips phasing for a sample when more than 20% of reads are untagged (src/snp_bam_processor.cpp:126-133,190-192) and still genotypes. Install pitfalls: README.md:20 and Makefile:96 clone over SSH (git@github.com:), and the default target (Makefile:40) git-pulls unpinned htslib and spoa and builds the unit tests (googletest). The repository's own test_data/test_regions_hg38.bed and test_data/job.sh still use the pre-v1.2 HipSTR layout, which this commit's parser rejects. The illustrative LongTR example in the benchmark README ('LongTR/HipSTR layout', strhub_has true) does not hold at this commit. --bams text says 'generated by BWA-MEM' (README.md:42), inherited from HipSTR; README.md:114 says any indel-sensitive aligner. Bioconda has longtr 1.2 but the README never mentions it.
